services.value: The Adirondack Watershed Institute supports research and monitoring work for environmental science, including long-term monitoring and lake & stream monitoring. Its laboratory and instruments are used for analytical work supporting environmental research, including monitoring acid and base cations, heavy metals (such as mercury), anions (such as chloride), total nitrogen and carbon, and pesticides.
